assertions.assertion: Replaces ICache<T> with HybridCache from Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid
assertions.rationale: Explicitly replaces ICache<Client> with HybridCache and references the Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid namespace/package.
Constructor injects [FromKeyedServices("ConfigurationStoreCache")] HybridCache and notes the ServiceProviderKeys.ConfigurationStoreCache constant.

assertions.assertion: Uses GetOrCreateAsync (not GetOrAddAsync) for the cache retrieval pattern
assertions.rationale: Uses _cache.GetOrCreateAsync with a factory and HybridCacheEntryOptions, explicitly noting it replaces GetOrAddAsync.
States CachingOptions.CacheLockTimeout is now obsolete because HybridCache handles stampede protection internally.
